active-ingredient.quote: contains brewer's yeast rich in B vitamins

health-feature.quote: improves the condition of the skin and coat

texts.about_this_item: 8in1 Excel Brewer's Yeast for large breeds is a feed supplement formulated to support the skin and coat of large dogs. It contains brewer's yeast rich in B vitamins, garlic, vitamins such as biotin and trace elements including copper and zinc, combined with fish oil as a source of omega-3 fatty acids. Brewer's yeast also supports normal metabolism and the immune system. Developed by veterinarians. 80 tablets.
